runway-gen3-alpha.v1_0_role_notes: Highest-fidelity general-purpose. v1.0 default for hero shots.

runway-gen3-alpha-turbo.v1_0_role_notes: Enterprise-only. Faster, slight quality concession. v1.0 anchor candidate for Enterprise tier.

pika-1.5.v1_0_role_notes: Best motion-graphics value at lower price point. v1.0 default for b-roll.

luma-dream-machine.v1_0_role_notes: Strong on cinematic motion; weaker on faces. Avoid for HeyGen-substitute scenarios.

flux-1.1.v1_0_role_notes: Image-first model; sequence frames composed. v1.0 default for static-feel b-roll, posters, opener frames.

kling-1.6.v1_0_role_notes: Strong on cinematic + character work. Mid-tier price.

higgsfield-v1.v1_0_role_notes: Specialty: camera motion / cinematic dollies / drone-style. Use sparingly.

heygen-v3-polish.v1_0_role_notes: Enterprise-only. Polish pass: blink/hand naturalism, voice consistency.
